nivelTanque.label: Tank Level
nivelTanque.nota: The level sensor sits on top of the distribution column, not on the tank.

cargaMotor.label: Motor Load
cargaMotor.nota: The historian does not publish a series of its own for this tag.

modoVdf.label: VFD Mode
modoVdf.nota: Auto/Manual mapping not confirmed against the server.

flujoInstantaneo.label: Instantaneous Flow Rate
flujoInstantaneo.nota: Unit not declared on the server.

presionRelativa.label: Gauge Pressure
presionRelativa.nota: Unit not declared on the server.

tensionLinea.label: Line Voltage
tensionLinea.nota: The tag is named "deviation index", but it delivers a voltage.

eficienciaEnergetica.label: Energy Efficiency
eficienciaEnergetica.nota: The historian does not publish a series of its own for this tag.

nivelAltoAlto.label: High-High Level
nivelAltoAlto.nota: Level above the critical upper limit. Overflow risk.

nivelAlto.label: High Level
nivelAlto.nota: Level above the warning upper limit.

nivelBajoBajo.label: Low-Low Level
nivelBajoBajo.nota: Level below the critical lower limit. Risk of the pump running dry.

nivelBajo.label: Low Level
nivelBajo.nota: Level below the warning lower limit.

faltaDePresion.label: Loss of Pressure
faltaDePresion.nota: Pressure absent with the pump running. Indicates lost prime, obstructed suction, or a leak.

bajoFlujo.label: Low Flow
bajoFlujo.nota: Flow below the minimum with the pump running.

fallaVariador.label: VFD Fault
fallaVariador.nota: Active fault reported by the drive.

control.label: Process Control
control.nota: Turns the process on and off. Not documented in the PLC's data block.

paroDeEmergencia.label: Emergency Stop
paroDeEmergencia.nota: State of the emergency-stop circuit. Polarity unconfirmed: not shown as an alarm.
